Dad Joke Generator

42 groan-worthy dad jokes and puns on demand — classic one-liners guaranteed to make everyone roll their eyes.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Tell Dad Jokes.
  2. Browse the pun lineup.
  3. Click any joke to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many dad jokes are there?

42 original-style dad jokes, from puns about gravity to jokes about time travel.

Are they clean?

All clean — safe for kids, classrooms, and family group chats.

How do I copy a joke?

Click any joke or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
